headline: Israeli minister Amichai Eliyahu calls Palestinians and Muslims camel riders in parliament speech
label: NEWS
caption:
An Israeli minister sparked massive outrage after directing racist slurs at Palestinians and Muslims during a parliamentary session. 🐪

According to Middle East Eye, outgoing Israeli Heritage Minister Amichai Eliyahu called Palestinians and Muslims camel riders and barbarians during a speech in the Knesset on Monday.

Eliyahu addressed Palestinian members of parliament and attacked Muslims worldwide while speaking during a discussion on crime in Palestinian society inside Israel.

He also claimed that they destroyed the Twin Towers and make a mess everywhere they touch, according to the report.

Eliyahu previously suggested that dropping an atomic bomb on the Gaza Strip was an option during a previous controversy.
